mechanisms.note: The Sphere's mast (as built, ElanElevator.cpp:682-692): a gilt column r 0.200 from its foot plane z 11.150 (the flange's underside, the mouth) to the car's under-floor seat (car floor datum - 0.160). The head's frame is the column's top on the axis at 11.150, drawn at zero length; it rises 0 -> 9.090 as the car's floor goes 11.310 -> 20.400 (atrium.car.height 0.793409 -> 1, ruled with the Atrium). Below 11.310 its length is 0 and it has no geometry. The column between the foot plane and the head is Motion's variable-length piece, never modelled at one length. Its footing: the foot ring (sphere.mast.foot) held on the four dogs (sphere.mast.dogs.1-4) from car floor 11.310 up; it leaves 0 only with the dogs at 1. Above car floor 11.410 (its base-ring guides off the rails) the car rides it alone.

The mast's foot ring (gilt CuSn10 annulus r 0.205-0.400, 0.058 deep; frame (0, 0, 11.150), the ring drawn at 11.152-11.210, i.e. its underside 2 mm over the dogs' top): below the car's stop 'mast' it rides the car, latched round the car's under-floor seat (car frame -0.158 ... -0.100; the car's lowest point stays the seat's -0.160), so it follows the car's height 1:1 (44.000 m per unit); from 'mast' up it rests on the four dogs and stays at 11.150 (the channel's clamp). The column's base is in its bore.

Bearing dog 1 of 4 at bearing 45 deg: a solid CuSn10 bar 0.160 wide x 0.300 deep x 3.060 long, top face z 11.150 (the mast's foot plane), bottom 10.850. Body frame at its tip's top face, retracted: r 2.560 (10 mm behind the throat's bore), (1.81, -1.81, 11.15); slides radially in 2.260 to its tip at r 0.300, 100 mm under the foot ring (r 0.205-0.400), keeping 0.800 in its housing. Housed in sphere.mast.dogs.housing.1, a box through the throat wall and out under the flange, r 2.550-5.650, z 10.830-11.150. Driven by the car's sequences through sphere.mast.dogs (0 retracted, 1 extended); extends only with the car floor above 11.300; retracts only with the mast at 0 and the car at stop 'mast'.
